ns2:section.sectionText: This class will allow students with an interest in start-ups, new venture creation, and entrepreneurship to explore this field through a mix of classroom lessons and hands-on projects. Course projects will require students to consult directly with a start-up company. This real world exposure will allow students to explore the exciting world of new venture creation and angel investing. This course will develop a deeper understanding of marketing, finance, operations, and business strategy through practical application.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MBA: (PT) Business Adm -- UIUC, MS: Technology Management-UIUC, or MBA:Bus Administration -UIUC.
